home.faqTitle: A few things to know before you start
home.faq1Question: Are my images uploaded to a server?
home.faq1Answer: By default, no. Core tools will process files in your browser. If a future feature requires a cloud service, it will explain that before use.
home.faq2Answer: Core tools are planned to be free without an account. Future ads will stay clearly separated from upload and download controls.
home.faq3Question: Can I use the site on a phone?
home.faq3Answer: Yes. The interface is designed for touch and small screens. Large images and AI features will show device limits and fallback options.
home.faq4Question: Will an ID photo always pass official review?
home.faq4Answer: No guarantee can be made. Requirements differ by authority, exam, and country, so always check the latest official rules before export.

compressor.intro: Image compression helps reduce the size of website graphics, assignments, and social media images while showing honest before-and-after sizes.
compressor.input: JPG, PNG, and WebP up to 25 MB each.
compressor.output: The original format, individually or as a ZIP archive.
compressor.limitations: PNG is re-encoded losslessly and may not shrink. The smaller version is kept by default.
compressor.step1: Drop or select between one and twenty images.
compressor.step2: Choose image quality and whether to keep originals when results are larger.
compressor.step3: Compress, compare sizes, then download individual files or a ZIP.
compressor.faq1Question: Why did some PNG files not get smaller?
compressor.faq1Answer: PNG content and original encoding vary widely. Browser-based lossless re-encoding cannot always reduce the size, and the tool does not claim a larger file as a successful compression.
compressor.faq2Answer: No. Compression keeps the pixel width and height. Use the resizer when dimensions need to change.

converter.intro: Format conversion helps images work in different apps, websites, and documents, including correct handling of transparency.
converter.output: JPG, PNG, and WebP, individually or as ZIP.
converter.limitations: Formats the browser cannot encode are disabled. Transparent images require a solid background when exported as JPG.
converter.step1: Choose one or more images to convert.
converter.step2: Select the output format, quality, and JPG background color.
converter.step3: Convert and download individual files or a ZIP.
converter.faq1Question: What happens to transparency when converting to JPG?
converter.faq1Answer: JPG has no transparent channel, so transparent pixels are filled with your selected background color.
converter.faq2Question: Does conversion change width and height?
converter.faq2Answer: No. Format conversion preserves pixel dimensions and aspect ratio.

resizer.intro: Resize images for thumbnails, social posts, or uploads that require specific pixel dimensions.
resizer.output: The original format, individually or as ZIP.
resizer.limitations: Upscaling cannot create missing detail. Very large canvases are blocked by memory protection.
resizer.step1: Upload images and choose pixels or percentage.
resizer.step2: Set width and height, keep the ratio locked, or use a common width.
resizer.step3: Process the images, verify actual dimensions, and download.
resizer.faq1Answer: Keep Lock ratio enabled so the other dimension follows the original aspect ratio.
resizer.faq2Question: Can images with different ratios be resized together?
resizer.faq2Answer: Yes. With ratio lock enabled, each image calculates its height from its own original ratio.

cropper.guideTitle: How to crop an image precisely
cropper.intro: Cropping changes composition, removes edge content, and creates common aspect ratios.
cropper.input: One JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
cropper.limitations: Pixels outside the white frame are removed. Export size follows the current frame after rotation.
cropper.step1: Choose an image and a free, fixed, or custom ratio.
cropper.step2: Drag the white frame to move it, resize from the lower-right handle, zoom, or rotate.
cropper.step3: Choose an output format and create the cropped result.
cropper.faq1Answer: Yes. Export uses the same original-image coordinates and rotation shown by the white crop frame.
cropper.faq2Question: Can I move the crop frame on a phone?
cropper.faq2Answer: Yes. The crop area uses pointer events for phones, tablets, and desktop input.

idPhoto.guideTitle: How to create an ID photo
idPhoto.intro: The ID photo editor combines background handling, common sizes, formal outfits, and subject positioning without default beautification or facial changes.
idPhoto.input: One clear, front-facing JPG, PNG, or WebP portrait.
idPhoto.output: JPG or PNG at the selected pixel dimensions.
idPhoto.limitations: The AI model downloads on first use. Complex hair, transparent objects, and similar foreground and background colors can affect edges. Official rules vary.
idPhoto.step1: Upload a clear portrait and run AI background removal when needed.
idPhoto.step2: Choose size, background, and outfit, then align the subject and collar.
idPhoto.step3: Check pixel and print dimensions, then export JPG or PNG.
idPhoto.faq1Question: Is my photo sent to an AI service?
idPhoto.faq1Answer: No. After the model downloads, portrait inference runs in a local browser Worker and the photo is not uploaded to the model service.
idPhoto.faq2Question: Will the photo pass every official review?
idPhoto.faq2Answer: No guarantee is possible. Passport, visa, exam, and ID rules differ, so check the latest authority requirements.

watermark.guideTitle: How to add watermarks in batches
watermark.intro: Watermarks can identify an author, shop, or sample status using text, images, fixed positions, or tiling.
watermark.input: JPG, PNG, and WebP; image watermarks use the same formats.
watermark.output: The original format, individually or as ZIP.
watermark.limitations: A watermark is written into exported pixels and cannot be removed losslessly. Keep the originals.
watermark.step1: Choose text or image watermark mode and add the target images.
watermark.step2: Adjust size, opacity, angle, position, or tiling.
watermark.step3: Check the preview, process the batch, and download.
watermark.faq1Question: Does watermark size adapt to different images?
watermark.faq1Answer: Yes. Size is calculated as a percentage of each image's shorter edge.
watermark.faq2Question: Can an image watermark have transparency?
watermark.faq2Answer: Yes. Transparent PNG watermark areas remain transparent when composited.

imageToPdf.guideTitle: How to combine images into PDF
imageToPdf.intro: Images to PDF is useful for scans, assignments, receipts, and presentations, with ordering and paper controls.
imageToPdf.input: Up to twenty JPG, PNG, or WebP images.
imageToPdf.limitations: Images are converted to page-appropriate JPEG to control file size. Many high-resolution images may still use substantial memory.
imageToPdf.step1: Upload images and drag cards or use arrows to set their order.
imageToPdf.step2: Choose paper, orientation, margins, and one- or four-image layout.
imageToPdf.step3: Review the page preview, create the PDF, and download it.
imageToPdf.faq1Answer: Pages follow the list from top to bottom. Drag cards or use the up and down arrows to reorder them.
imageToPdf.faq2Question: Why are images compressed in the PDF?
imageToPdf.faq2Answer: Moderate compression reduces file size and browser memory use while keeping pages readable.

about.title: About Image Toolbox
about.description: Image Toolbox provides free Chinese and English tools for everyday image tasks without registration.
about.section1Body: Compress, convert, resize, crop, watermark, create ID photos, or organize images into PDF.
about.section2Body: We show honest results and limitations. There are no fake download buttons or mandatory ads before saving.
about.section3Body: Image quality, usability, and device compatibility guide improvements. ID photos do not change facial features by default.

privacy.title: Privacy by design
privacy.description: Images are processed in your current browser, without automatic uploads, image analytics logs, or model training.
privacy.section1Body: Images stay in page memory. Closing or refreshing the page loses edits. Output files are saved only when you download them. Original images are not stored persistently by the website.
privacy.section2Body: AI removal downloads MODNet files on demand. The model host receives ordinary file requests and connection information, but no photo pixels. Your browser may cache models. Theme and ad consent preferences are stored only on your device and can be removed using browser site-data settings.
privacy.section3Body: Real ads are disabled by default. Future advertising requires applicable consent; rejecting ad cookies does not affect tools. No third-party analytics scripts currently load. Operating details and regional consent requirements must be completed before enabling advertising.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Make sure you have permission to process the images and keep important original files.
terms.section1Body: You retain your image rights and are responsible for respecting copyright, likeness, and privacy rights. Do not use the tools for unlawful purposes.
terms.section2Body: Encoding, compression, and background removal depend on source images and device capabilities. Review exports and keep backups. Official ID, exam, passport, and visa photos must follow the latest authority specifications.
terms.section3Body: Basic tools require no account. Features may change with browser capabilities and maintenance needs. Viewing ads is not a condition for downloading.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: This is a local preview and no public support email has been configured.
contact.section1Body: Record the tool, browser version, file format, settings, and error message. You can describe problems without sharing private photos.
contact.section2Body: Suggestions for common sizes, export formats, and usability improvements are welcome.
contact.section3Body: The operating entity and support channel will be published once confirmed. This page does not collect or submit contact forms.
